UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with language learning statistics and daily streaks.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

targetLanguage.description: Active learning language (e.g., Japanese, Spanish, French).

totalMinutesPracticed.description: Total speaking practice time in minutes.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VocabItem.title: VocabItem
VocabItem.description: A vocabulary word or phrase tracked for mastery.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Log of a voice conversation or roleplay session with Pocket Sensei.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

avgScore.description: Average pronunciation score for this session.

feedbackSummary.description: Sensei feedback on accent and grammar.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Global or league community leaderboard record for a learner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

leagueTier.description: Current league tier: White Belt, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Black Belt.

totalXp.description: Accumulated experience points from accent drills and roleplay.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UsageQuota.title: UsageQuota
UsageQuota.description: Daily AI usage ledger and eco-mode preferences synced per user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

graceClaimed.description: Whether daily grace credits were claimed today.

ecoLiteMode.description: Whether Eco Lite AI model routing is enabled.

fallbackCascadeCount.description: Number of times requests cascaded to Eco Lite or Local coach today.

dateIso.description: Current UTC/local calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format.

updatedAt.description: Last sync timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document containing learning stats and streaks.

/users/{userId}/vocab/{vocabId}.description: Subcollection of vocabulary words mastered or practiced by the user.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Subcollection of voice conversation session history.

/users/{userId}/usageQuota/{quotaId}.description: Daily AI credit tracking document synced with local SharedPreferences.

/leaderboard/{entryUserId}.description: Community speaking league leaderboard document for each learner.
